name: Kinetic Type Teaser
tagline: A 10–30 second kinetic typography teaser for launches and announcements, in five styles, with no footage.
youSay: /kinetic-type-teaser Make a 12-second vertical teaser for our launch 'Orbit 2.0' on 1 Dec, orbit.app
whatYouGet: A teaser of big words on hard cuts with one accent colour, 10–30 seconds
Five styles: loud, swiss, memphis, xerox and bauhaus
Ten beats, from a single word and a flash to a typed line, an odometer and a split
MP4 in 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1, every frame rendered on its own, plus the teaser as an editable HTML page
goodFit: Coming-soon posts and story or reel teasers
notFor: Videos with footage, voice-over or music
youBring: What's happening, the brand, a date or URL
needs: Google Chrome or Edge (or Playwright's Chromium)

network.purpose: playwright-core for the renderer, installed once
